interpretation.selection: development only; final recipes frozen before test evaluation
interpretation.oracle_gate: User mean-gain rule: fixed recipe has positive three-update-seed average versus the same warmup on development and independent confirmation. No per-seed, minimum2pp, base-model or CI admission threshold. Original strict-rule results remain archived; mean-positive is not a significance claim.
interpretation.statistics: paired cluster and update-seed bootstrap, conditional on one fixed warmup; primary-family intervals and separate conservative intervals including every registered exploratory recipe, per contrast
interpretation.exploration: Exploratory recipe variants share their source benchmark and are not additional independent benchmarks; retain original negative results and all registered attempts
interpretation.retention: Ratio of paired predictor gain to paired oracle gain above warmup; point estimate only, flagged unstable if the oracle denominator is not clearly positive
interpretation.new_tasks: generation protocol; not comparable to standard likelihood benchmark leaderboards
